description: This file contains authentication service functions for a React frontend, utilizing Supabase for auth management. It includes functions for session retrieval, auth state subscription, email sign-in, sign-up, and sign-out.

methods.name: getCurrentSession
methods.description: Retrieves the current Supabase auth session, returning null if not authenticated.

methods.name: onAuthStateChange
methods.description: Subscribes to auth state changes and executes a callback with the current session; returns an unsubscribe function.

methods.name: signInWithEmail
methods.description: Sends a magic link email for sign-in to the provided email address.

methods.name: signUpWithEmail
methods.description: Initiates a passwordless sign-up flow using email magic link.
